sentences.text:
Sk,J
 The Hon'Ble Sri Justice K.Sarath
 Writ Petition No.9365 Of 2016
Order:

1. This Writ Petition is filed questioning the action of the respondent Nos. 1 to 5 in laying the road from Hyderabad-Tandur main road to Village Gram Panchayat of Kanapur across the petitioners'
lands situated in various survey numbers situated at Kandinepally and Khanpur villages, Peddemul Mandal, without following due process of law and sought a direction to the respondent Nos. 1 to 5 not to dispossess the petitioners from their respective subjects lands without following due process of law.
2. Heard the learned Counsel for the petitioners as well as the learned Assistant Government Pleader for Panchayat Raj and Rural Development, learned Standing Counsel for Gram Panchayat,
appearing for the official respondents.
3.

While admitting the Writ Petition this Court granted interim orders on 22.03.2016 directing the SK,J respondents not to dispossess the petitioners from the subjects lands without following due process of law.
In spite of lapse of more than eight years, the respondents did not chose to file counter or vacate petition denying the averments of the petition.
4. In view of the same, this Writ Petition is disposed of directing the respondents not to dispossess the petitioners from their respective subject lands, without following due process of law.

If the respondents wants to acquire the subjects lands, they have to follow the rules as contemplated under Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.
